clean_repro.observed: HTTP 200 with response [{"name": "tenant_empty"}]. Tenant created successfully with empty activityStatus

violated_assumptions: Original defect assertion assumes that activityStatus must be one of {ACTIVE, INACTIVE} on create
The assertion incorrectly treats empty string as an invalid value when the contract explicitly allows it

contract_refs: contract endpoint description: "Array of Tenant objects (activityStatus: ACTIVE|INACTIVE on create)"
Note: The contract description explicitly states activityStatus is OPTIONAL on create, not REQUIRED

source_grounding.call_chain_traced: POST /schema/{className}/tenants → handlers_schema.go:createTenants → tenant.go:AddTenants (line 40) → validateActivityStatuses(ctx, validated, true, false) (line 63, allowEmpty=true) → switch case allows empty string when allowEmpty=true (line 157-159)
source_grounding.note: 源码接地发现:空字符串activityStatus在创建租户时被显式允许。AddTenants函数调用validateActivityStatuses时传入allowEmpty=true(line 63),当status为空且allowEmpty=true时直接continue通过验证(line 157-159)。模型层验证也显示ActivityStatus为非必填字段(line 110-112)。这是有意的设计,不是缺陷。

falsification.observed: Tenant确实被创建成功,返回 activityStatus=HOT(默认值)。empty string不是bug,而是被API接受并处理为默认状态。

mundane_explanation.note: 原始defect assertion误解了API契约。Contract明确指出activityStatus在创建时是可选的(默认为ACTIVE),而断言错误地将其视为必填且只能为{ACTIVE, INACTIVE}。

verdicts.rationale: 原始oracle断言'POST /schema/{className}/tenants应拒绝空字符串activityStatus'是对契约的误读。源码显示:1)contract明确说明activityStatus在创建时可选(描述:activityStatus: ACTIVE|INACTIVE on create,但模型注释显示This field is optional and defaults to ACTIVE);2)源码validateActivityStatuses函数在AddTenants中用allowEmpty=true调用,显式允许空字符串(line 157-159);3)模型层验证将ActivityStatus视为非必填字段(line 110-112)。实测也证实API接受空值并返回HTTP 200,tenant成功创建。此行为是by-design,非缺陷。
